This No Kings Day on March 28 is more important than ever.

Find your local protest at nokings.org

Video

Flying already sucks.

It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages.

But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.

Video

So what will America have gotten out of Trump’s “excursion” in Iran? Zilch. Actually, less than zilch because in many ways we’re worse off than when it started. But that won't stop him from declaring "victory." Some thoughts... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Nexstar and Tegna’s merger was just given a special green light by Trump’s FCC.

Never heard of these companies? Well, they could soon control your local news stations. Watch.

Video

Tyranny cannot succeed where people refuse to submit to it.

Next Saturday, on the third No Kings Day, we will proclaim our refusal to submit. 

We will reaffirm that America Belongs to us. Some thoughts...
robertreich.substack.com/p/s…

You might hear people say that protesting doesn’t make a difference.

Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares why that’s not true.

Video

Trump has no plan for his war on Iran.

He can’t even come up with a coherent justification for it.

Meanwhile, his economy is tanking and even some of his supporters are jumping ship.

Is this the week the tide turns on him for good? piped.video/VgiQmE71XuY

Yesterday, Trump said that he’d do whatever is necessary to ease the oil crisis. He also assured America that the crisis “will be over soon.” I'm calling bullshit. Here's why he's trapped in Iran.

robertreich.substack.com/p/p…

The average annual electric bill in the U.S. increased by $110 during Trump’s first year in office.

Remember when he promised to lower energy costs on the campaign trail?

That’s far from the only promise he’s broken.

piped.video/watch?v=AcefFTXU…

Trump repeatedly promised on the campaign trail to cap credit card interest rates at 10 percent.

But since he took office, Americans have paid nearly $240.7B in credit card interest — $134.5B more than what they would have paid under a 10 percent cap.

Like so many of his promises, it was another lie. piped.video/watch?v=vZwV58Dd…

When 3.5% of a population actively participates in sustained, peaceful protest, it can topple authoritarian regimes — like the one currently in the Oval Office.

We need 12 million people to show up on March 28 to get to 3.5%. Will you be one of them?

Find out how at nokings.org

Video

Trump is alone. That’s different from the United States being alone.

May I be so bold as to address myself to America’s allies and friends? I have some thoughts... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

The AI lobby has spent millions of dollars on today's Democratic primary elections in Illinois.

Why?

To buy itself a Congress that will do its bidding.

Video

Trump is realizing he bit off more than he could chew by attacking Iran and unleashing global economic chaos.

Video

Adam Smith’s masterpiece is one of those rare classics that almost everyone knows about, but a very few have actually read.

It is fundamentally misunderstood — yet it's just as important today as it was in 1776. Let me explain. robertreich.substack.com/p/t…
The war in Iran is an American failure. What do we do now? theguardian.com/commentisfre…
Flying Already Sucks. Trump Just Made It Worse.
Trump Just Created a Media Monopoly
Why Protests Matter (ft. "No Kings" organizer)
Trump Loses His War, Economy, and Mind | The Coffee Klatch with Robert Reich
We Need You on March 28 #nokings
How She Beat Trump (ft. E Jean Carroll)
How Trump's Iran War Ends
Trump Sold You Out to Credit Card Companies (ft. Rohit Chopra)
The Epstein Cover-Up Continues
Hegseth's Lobster Dinner on Your Dime

Who knew what? When did they know it? How close were they to Trump's inner circle?

And can anyone within or around the orbit of this regime be trusted to put the interests of the American public above their own pocketbook?

It is maddening that we even need to ask these questions.

Trump is throttling renewable energy production, which can help guard against volatile oil price spikes.

Instead, he’s forcing companies to invest in dirty fossil fuels, whose prices are soaring due to his war on Iran.

Everyone loses under Trump — except Big Oil.

The Wall Street Journal — hardly an outpost of left-wing propaganda — reported yesterday on the results of an investigation conducted into Trump's weaponization of ICE.  

Here's what you should know (plus some additional thoughts)... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/a-report-you-need-to-read
It’s not about what this country can or can’t afford. It’s about priorities.
Democracy dies in billionaire hands.

Trump sent ICE agents to airports after refusing to go along with a deal that would have funded the TSA.

If you thought that was the only way Trump was making flying even more miserable, you'd be wrong. Watch.

Trump says that he will not approve TSA funding unless it's tied to passage of his voter suppression law, also known as the SAVE Act — or the SAVE Trump's Ass Act.

He knows that he and Republicans are doomed in the midterms, and the only way to combat that is to make it harder for people to vote.

This No Kings Day on March 28 is more important than ever.

Find your local protest at nokings.org.
Doing nothing to actually fix the problem at hand, while actively making it worse for everyone. The Trump agenda in a nutshell.

Despite Trump's false claims of slashing drug prices, Big Pharma has already RAISED prices on 64 cancer drugs this year.

This comes after Big Pharma gave millions to Trump's inaugural and reaped huge tax breaks and handouts from his Big Ugly Bill. 

"Make America Healthy Again."

As the death toll and cost of living continue to surge from Trump's war on Iran, where is JD Vance?

Attending RNC fundraisers with billionaire megadonors, real estate developers, venture capital executives, and a former private prison CEO.

Hello?
This is why you always follow the money...

Flying already sucks.

It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages.

But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.

Violations of child labor laws are on the rise in the U.S.

But since 2021, 30 states have proposed legislation that would roll back child labor protections and regulations, with 17 states enacting rollbacks. Most of these states are controlled by Republicans.

So much for protecting children.

Reminder that DHS funding has lapsed because Trump and Republicans have refused to accept modest reforms for ICE — a rogue agency that has killed American citizens, brutalized immigrant communities, and detained thousands of residents (both citizen and noncitizen) while violating due process.

Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Tesla paid just 4.9% of their profits in federal corporate taxes in 2025.

They have seen their collective tax bill drop by $95B thanks to two rounds of Trump tax cuts.

Meanwhile, they've laid off thousands of workers.

Trickle-down economics was always a scam.

Senate Democrats voted multiple times to fund TSA separately from ICE. Republicans voted it down every time.

Republicans are to blame for today’s airport chaos — all because they’re happy to keep letting Trump’s thugs terrorize our communities with no consequences.

Remember this.

11,000 children who don’t know if they’ll ever get to see their parents again.

Who are forced to live with friends or even strangers.

Whose lives will never be the same again.

This is Trump’s legacy.
https://www.propublica.org/article/trump-family-deportations-ice-citizen-kids

Trump’s war on Iran has cost close to $30 billion.

That could fund a year of the Affordable Care Act subsidies that he and Republicans have refused to extend.

Instead, millions of Americans have dropped their insurance because they can’t afford it.

Priorities.

Edward R. Murrow famously used his platform on CBS to criticize the witch hunts led by Joseph McCarthy in the 1950s.

He got his start on CBS Radio, which will sadly be shut down after nearly 100 years of operation.

We need more journalists holding the powerful accountable like this.
Flying already sucks. It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages. But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.
Nexstar and Tegna’s merger was just given a special green light by Trump’s FCC. Never heard of these companies? Well, they could soon control your local news stations. Watch.
You might hear people say that protesting doesn’t make a difference. Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares why that’s not true.

When 3.5% of a population actively participates in sustained, peaceful protest, it can topple authoritarian regimes — like the one currently in the Oval Office. We need 12 million people to show up on March 28 to get to 3.5%. Will you be one of them? Find out how at nokings.org
Trump is realizing he bit off more than he could chew by attacking Iran and unleashing global economic chaos.
Trump promised a cap on credit card rates. Instead, he delivered a giveaway to credit card companies at your expense. Former CFPB Director Rohit Chopra explains.
It’s fallen out of the news cycle, but Trump’s FBI and Justice Department are still covering up major details in the Epstein files.
The Pentagon was already one of the biggest culprits of waste, fraud, and abuse. Now we find out Pete Hegseth has been spending our money on steak and lobster?
E. Jean Carroll, one of my personal heroes, took on Trump and won. She’s one of the bravest people I’ve met. She shared some thoughts on Trump and Epstein’s awful friendship.
Today I want to tell you about my favorite sandwich, where to get it, and some other very important information you might not have heard before.
